structure.method: Time-normalized tonal, energy and spectral fingerprints

timing.alignment: Neural pulse with local tempo and nearby measured PCM attacks

diagnostics.limitations: Low-register harmonic estimates can include piano, low voice or tuned sustained drums. Brief or sweeping kick transients are suppressed; overlapping instruments, glides and quiet bass can be missed. Kicks overlapping a low note can still move its estimated boundary; the 5 ms boundary grid is not an accuracy guarantee.
diagnostics.boundaryMethod: Exact-frequency harmonic amplitudes in local PCM

vocals.method: PretrainedSED Frame-MN10 strong singing events with confidence-gated phrasing

timing.alignment: 40 ms sound-event evidence with estimated phrase edges and accents; no separated vocal stem or word alignment

diagnostics.confidenceMeaning: Relative evidence score; not a calibrated probability

engine.name: Beat This! full transformer
engine.detail: Bundled pretrained Beat This! transformer with exact exported log-mel frontend, overlapping 30-second context, measured PCM attack alignment and recurring-passage fingerprints, plus independent PretrainedSED Frame-MN10 singing evidence and harmonic bass-note estimates. All audio stays on this device.
